districtClarification.publisher: Tri County Area Schools current district website
districtClarification.quote:
On November 3, 2026 there you will see two Tri County Area School ballot questions.

Non-Homestead Operating Millage: A renewal of 18 mills for four years, expected to generate approximately $3.3–$3.6 million annually for daily district operations. This millage does not apply to primary residences.
Sinking Fund: A new 1.5-mill proposal for 10 years, expected to generate approximately $1.06 million in its first year for eligible facility repairs, safety upgrades, transportation updates, new technology, and career and technical education needs.
